name: Noordhaven Logistics B.V.
summary: Dutch logistics and warehousing company, 1,200 employees on three sites (Rotterdam, Tilburg, Venlo). About 750 work in warehouses and transport on shifts, 450 in offices. Collective labour agreement (CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer and own warehouse CAO), a works council (OR), and 150 to 300 flex workers through staffing agencies depending on the season.
